title: Storing medications in manufacturer stock bottles or fully labeled stock containers
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.19(5), a pharmacy shall store medications in the manufacturer's stock bottles or in other stock containers that are clearly labeled with the product name, strength or concentration, NDC number, manufacturer or supplier, lot number, assigned expiration date, and date that the medication was transferred out of its original stock bottle.
exam_relevance: Tests the label content a stock container other than the manufacturer's stock bottle must carry, including lot number and the transfer date.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The stock-container label under 247 CMR 9.19(5) includes the lot number and the date of transfer out of the original stock bottle; the return-to-stock label list in 247 CMR 9.13(1)(b) does not name either.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
